title: test_user_login_with_valid_credentials
description: Verify that POST /api/auth/login with valid username and password returns 200 with an ApiResponse envelope whose data object contains accessToken and expiresIn, and that the accessToken can be used to access protected endpoints.

title: test_create_new_user
description: Verify that POST /api/users with valid username and password creates a new user and returns 200 with ApiResponse.data as UserDto, and that the user can be retrieved and assigned roles.

title: test_create_role_with_valid_data
description: Verify that POST /api/roles with valid roleCode, roleName, and description creates a new role and returns 200 with ApiResponse.data as RoleDto.

title: test_create_page_and_autogenerate_permissions
description: Verify that POST /api/pages with valid page data creates a page and auto-generates CRUD permissions, returning 200 with ApiResponse.data as PageResponse.

title: test_create_legal_entity
description: Verify that POST /api/v1/org/legal-entities with valid data creates a legal entity and returns 200 with ApiResponse.data as LegalEntityResponse.

title: test_create_master_lookup
description: Verify that POST /api/masterdata/master-lookups with valid lookupKey and names creates a master lookup and returns 200 with ApiResponse.data as MasterLookupResponse.

title: test_issue_file_upload_token_and_upload_file
description: Verify that POST /api/v1/files/upload-token issues a valid encrypted upload token (in ApiResponse.data), and that POST /upload/{encryptedToken} with multipart file uploads the file successfully.

title: test_send_notification_immediately
description: Verify that POST /api/v1/notifications/send with valid notification payload sends notification immediately and returns 200 with ApiResponse.data as NotificationSendConfirmation.

title: test_get_user_menu_for_current_user
description: Verify that GET /api/menu/user-menu with valid JWT returns 200 with ApiResponse.data as the hierarchical menu filtered by VIEW permissions for the current user.

title: test_assign_branch_scope_to_role
description: Verify that POST /api/v1/security/role-branches with valid roleIdFk, branchIdFk, and dataAccessLevel assigns branch-level data access scope to a role and returns 200 with ApiResponse.data as SecRoleBranchDto.

title: test_notification_unread_endpoint_returns_known_422
description: Verify that GET /api/v1/notifications/unread returns HTTP 422 with error code NOTIF_READ_TRACKING_UNAVAILABLE, matching the documented known limitation (no read/unread column in NOTIF_LOG).

title: test_login_with_invalid_credentials_returns_401
description: Verify that POST /api/auth/login with an invalid username/password returns a 401/error ApiResponse envelope with success:false, and that protected endpoints reject requests without a valid Authorization header.
